proposals.evidence: The full DEDR 4572 article gives Malayalam pōka to go, go away, go towards, be lost, be able; verbal n. pōkal; pōkku going, passing off, way, exit, escape; pōkkan wanderer; pōkkuka to make to go, remove; pōkkal removing, passing over.. The Malayalam survey form pōyi “go” is proposed within this article family.
